description.value: The study examined functional connectivity changes associated with right inferior frontal cortex fMRI neurofeedback training in adolescents with ADHD, with a left parahippocampal neurofeedback group serving as a control.

spans.text: In the current study, we were particularly interested in the effects of rIFC self-regulation training in ADHD on functional connectivity with other brain networks.

Each fMRI-Neurofeedback run consisted of seven rest (30s) and six activation (50s) blocks, starting with a rest block showing an underwater dolphin image, while activation blocks showed a video-clip of a rocket.

instructions.value: Participants were asked to move the rocket towards space by any means they found helpful; instructions were minimal, such as “you can try to concentrate on the rocket” or “try any other method that works for you”.
